Ref: P.F. 60074.

B.6.

I should be grateful if you would obtain for me the birth certificate of Arthur William OLDAG. This man who was born on 10.4.05. at St. Pancras, London, is the illegitimate son of a German mother and a Scottish father.

F.3.m.
6.7.44.

F.3.m.

Copy birth certificate herewith.

B.6.
8.7.44.

R.G. Micklethwait.

H. Hunter.
